verses.text: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD'S, and all it contains, The world, and those who dwell in it.
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩。）地和其中所充滿的，世界和住在其間的，都屬耶和華。

verses.text: For He has founded it upon the seas And established it upon the rivers.
verses.textZh: 他把地建立在海上，安定在大水之上。

verses.text: Who may ascend into the hill of the LORD? And who may stand in His holy place?
verses.textZh: 誰能登耶和華的山？誰能站在他的聖所？

verses.text: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, Who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood And has not sworn deceitfully.
verses.textZh: 就是手潔心清、不向虛妄、起誓不懷詭詐的人。

verses.text: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD And righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.textZh: 他必蒙耶和華賜福，又蒙救他的神使他成義。

verses.text: This is the generation of those who seek Him, Who seek Your face-- [even] Jacob. Selah.
verses.textZh: 這是尋求耶和華的族類，是尋求你面的雅各。（細拉）

verses.text: Lift up your heads, O gates, And be lifted up, O ancient doors, That the King of glory may come in!
verses.textZh: 眾城門哪，你們要抬起頭來！永久的門戶，你們要被舉起！那榮耀的王將要進來！

verses.text: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, The LORD mighty in battle.
verses.textZh: 榮耀的王是誰呢？就是有力有能的耶和華，在戰場上有能的耶和華！

verses.text: Lift up your heads, O gates, And lift [them] up, O ancient doors, That the King of glory may come in!
verses.textZh: 眾城門哪，你們要抬起頭來！永久的門戶，你們要把頭抬起！那榮耀的王將要進來！

verses.text: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, He is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.textZh: 榮耀的王是誰呢？萬軍之耶和華，他是榮耀的王！（細拉）
